variable_parameters.name: activity_delay_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: engineering request for activity start, not legal cutoff

variable_parameters.name: provisions_effective
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: true or false from original provision and civil clock

variable_parameters.name: zone_boundary_offset_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: -0.5 through +0.5 m engineering offset from source-reviewed marked boundary

variable_parameters.name: zone_boundary_signed_distance_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: measured original halt-position distance to marked polygon

variable_parameters.name: civil_clock_offset_min
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: -30 through +30 min engineering clock offset from sourced provision boundary

variable_parameters.name: civil_boundary_offset_min
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: measured original civil time offset from sourced provision boundary

variable_parameters.name: passenger_dwell_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 2 through 10 s engineering passenger activity duration request

variable_parameters.name: freight_entry_headway_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 0 through 4 s engineering freight arrival request

variable_parameters.name: observed_freight_entry_headway_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: measured original freight approach event time from ego halt
